name: insightgo
description: Local business insight platform with an integrated churn prediction module (LightGBM ensemble + SHAP/LIME XAI + Q-learning feedback loop).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && python3 -m venv ml-service/.venv && ml-service/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip -q && ml-service/.venv/bin/pip install -r ml-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,ml-service -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run start --prefix server" "ml-service/.venv/bin/python3 ml-service/predict.py"
